description: Unofficial: not made, endorsed or supported by Shelly Group SE. Shelly is a trademark of Shelly Group SE. Relay state, power, energy and its cost, supply and device health of a Shelly Gen2 relay, from shelly-bridge.

panels.title: Relay
panels.description: Whether the relay, and so whatever it powers, is on. The bridge only reads this; it cannot switch the relay.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Active power right now, as the device measures it. No data when the device has not been read for three poll intervals. Power over time is below.

panels.title: Energy
panels.description: Energy used in the selected time range, from the bridge's energy counter (shelly_switch_energy_joules_total). Energy used while the bridge was not running is not in it.

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Cost of the energy in the selected time range. Cost uses the Tibber price: each 15-minute slot's energy times that slot's total price (energy plus tax) from tibber_power_price{type="total"}, which the tibber-exporter publishes. A slot without a price uses the latest price of the hour before it. With more than one Tibber home, the highest price is used. No data means there is no Tibber price, or no energy reading for this device, in the range. Energy used while the device could not be read is counted in the slot in which it answered again, for outages of up to a day. Energy used while the bridge was not running is not counted, here or in Energy.

panels.title: Device temperature
panels.description: Temperature inside the device. The device turns the relay off by itself when it overheats and reports an overtemp error. Orange from 80 °C, red from 90 °C: a rough guide, not Shelly's limit.

panels.title: Last poll
panels.description: Whether the bridge's most recent poll of the device worked. The Bridge row at the bottom has the history and the reasons.

panels.title: Power over time
panels.description: Average active power in each point's time step, so a short heating cycle still shows at long time ranges. Gaps are times the device could not be read or the bridge was not running.

panels.title: Relay over time
panels.description: On when the relay was on at any moment in the time step. Gaps are times the device could not be read.

panels.title: Energy per day
panels.description: Energy used per day. Each bar is one day, from midnight to midnight in the dashboard's time zone, and starts at that midnight. Grafana takes the UTC offset at the end of the selected range, so across a change to or from daylight saving time the days on the other side are shifted by an hour. Today's bar grows during the day.

panels.title: Cost per day
panels.description: Cost of the energy used per day, on the same days as Energy per day. Each bar is one day, from midnight to midnight in the dashboard's time zone, and starts at that midnight. Grafana takes the UTC offset at the end of the selected range, so across a change to or from daylight saving time the days on the other side are shifted by an hour. Today's bar grows during the day. Cost uses the Tibber price: each 15-minute slot's energy times that slot's total price (energy plus tax) from tibber_power_price{type="total"}, which the tibber-exporter publishes. A slot without a price uses the latest price of the hour before it. With more than one Tibber home, the highest price is used. No data means there is no Tibber price, or no energy reading for this device, in the range. Energy used while the device could not be read is counted in the slot in which it answered again, for outages of up to a day. Energy used while the bridge was not running is not counted, here or in Energy.

panels.title: Voltage
panels.description: Supply voltage at the device, averaged per time step.

panels.title: Current
panels.description: Current through the relay, averaged per time step.

panels.title: Firmware
panels.description: Firmware version the device reports.

panels.title: Firmware update
panels.description: Whether Shelly offers a newer stable firmware for the device. The bridge never installs anything.

panels.title: Restart required
panels.description: Whether the device needs a restart to apply a setting.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the device last started.

panels.title: Protection errors
panels.description: Protection errors the device reports right now: overtemp, overpower, overvoltage, undervoltage, or other. The device turns the relay off while one is active. None means the device reports no error; No data means it was not read.

panels.title: Shelly Cloud
panels.description: Whether the device is connected to Shelly Cloud. The bridge does not use the cloud.

panels.title: Device temperature over time
panels.description: Temperature inside the device, averaged per time step.

panels.title: Wi-Fi signal
panels.description: Wi-Fi signal strength at the device. Around -50 dBm is excellent; below about -80 dBm polls start to time out.

panels.title: Since last good poll
panels.description: How long ago the bridge last read the device. Readings disappear when this passes three poll intervals (45 s by default). It keeps counting while the bridge is down. No good poll means none in the whole selected range.

panels.title: Poll duration
panels.description: How long the most recent poll took. With authentication on, every call needs two round trips.

panels.title: Poll success
panels.description: 1 while polls succeed. A dip to 0 is a failed poll in that time step.

panels.title: Failed polls
panels.description: Failed polls per bar, by reason: timeout, connection (refused or no route), auth (password missing or wrong), http (an error status) or invalid_response. Each bar counts the failures in the time step that ends at it, at least a minute. The bridge log has the details.
